label: Outlet-UsExit
remarks: Dead End outlet; start from the master WSE and raise the downstream stage until the branch backwater matches the solved junction stage.

label: Outlet-forebay
remarks: Spill End outlet; start from the master WSE and adjust the downstream stage up or down while spill is relaxed from zero.

label: Outlet-sidechannel
remarks: Spill End outlet; start from the master WSE and adjust the downstream stage up or down while spill is relaxed from zero.
